financials_interim.notes: Same source as GROUP row (source_id 52713), Company column, six months ended 30 Jun 2026: Statement of Comprehensive Income p.3 (doc p.04), SOFP p.2 (doc p.03), Cash Flow p.7 (doc p.08). Company (standalone parent, i.e. essentially the Mobile business only -- Company revenue of Rs.73,251,657k equals the 'Mobile operation' segment's revenue-from-contracts figure in Note 15 exactly, confirming Fixed telephony/broadband and Television operate through separate subsidiaries not in the Company's own standalone accounts) revenue +11.0% YoY (Rs.73,251,657k vs Rs.65,974,666k), Operating profit +52.5% to Rs.20,856,029k (2025: Rs.13,678,008k), PBT +94.1% to Rs.17,755,609k (2025: Rs.9,147,578k), PAT +129.5% to Rs.15,778,906k (2025: Rs.6,875,475k) -- all growing faster at Company level than at Group level, meaning the Fixed telephony/broadband and Television subsidiaries (consolidated only at Group level) grew more slowly than the parent Mobile business this period; this is consistent with the Fixed telephony/broadband segment's revenue DECLINE noted at Group level (see GROUP row notes). Company net foreign exchange gain of Rs.102,863k vs a loss of Rs.(808,632)k in H1 2025 (a Rs.911,495k favourable swing) and gross finance costs down 15.1% YoY (3,602,550 vs 4,242,465) both contributed to 'Finance costs - net' improving 31.6% to Rs.(3,100,420)k from Rs.(4,530,430)k. Company effective tax rate fell to 11.1% (1,976,703/17,755,609) from 24.8% (2,272,103/9,147,578) in H1 2025 -- an even larger tax-rate compression than at Group level, and again not explained by any note in this filing (same disclosure gap as GROUP row, more pronounced at Company level). eps_basic=eps_diluted=1.72. Cross-check: 15,778,906k*1,000 / 9,200,334,994 shares = Rs.1.7150, rounds to disclosed 1.72. minority_interest = 0 (n/a, standalone Company accounts). depreciation_amortization left NULL for Company -- Note 3's depreciation/amortization/impairment breakdown is Group-segment only, no separate Company-only figure disclosed (genuine gap). Balance sheet: trade_receivables = 'Trade and other receivables' (18,962,759k); trade_payables = 'Trade and other payables' (80,033,388k, current) -- NOTE this is LARGER than Company Total Current Assets' trade receivables and even exceeds Group's own trade payables figure, consistent with substantial intercompany/related-party payables to subsidiaries embedded in this line at Company level (not separately disclosed -- a gap). short_term_borrowings = 'Borrowings' (current, 37,661,177k); long_term_borrowings = 'Borrowings' (non-current, 17,712,000k); same lease-liability exclusion as GROUP row applies (Company lease liabilities: current 1,942,705k + non-current 10,314,608k = 12,257,313k, not included). cash_and_equivalents = 'Cash and cash equivalents' (17,653,208k), gross, same SOFP-face convention as GROUP row. capex = 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' only (8,634,961k), excluding 'Purchase of intangible assets' (1,339,648k) and 'Investment in subsidiaries' (308,580k, a financing/investing item, not capex) -- same convention as GROUP row. cash_from_operations = 43,054,498k; cash_from_investing = -10,283,189k; cash_from_financing = -28,481,104k (includes the same Rs.27,030,970k ordinary dividend paid as at Group level, since dividends are paid by the listed parent Company).

Source: Dialog Axiata PLC (Group) condensed consolidated interim FS for the six months ended 30 Jun 2026 (Deloitte-reviewed, not audited, signed 14 Aug 2026). First financial_statements entry for DIAL -- no prior period in this DB. Statement of Comprehensive Income (6-month, cumulative) p.3 (doc p.04), Statement of Financial Position p.2 (doc p.03), Cash Flow p.7 (doc p.08), Segment note 3 p.8-9 (doc p.09-10). Three reportable segments: Mobile operation, Fixed telephony and broadband operation, Television operation. HEADLINE: Group revenue +9.3% YoY to Rs.95,515,048k (H1 2025: Rs.87,419,671k); Operating profit +51.2% to Rs.25,857,444k (2025: Rs.17,106,020k); PBT +87.1% to Rs.22,509,992k (2025: Rs.12,032,324k); PAT +110.0% to Rs.19,300,739k (2025: Rs.9,192,642k) -- profit grew several multiples faster than revenue, driven by margin expansion, a favourable net finance-cost/FX swing, and a lower effective tax rate all stacking in the same direction. BY SEGMENT (Note 3, external revenue): Mobile +10.9% YoY to Rs.74,228,326k (2025: Rs.66,925,508k, 77.7% of Group revenue); Fixed telephony & broadband DECLINED 1.9% YoY to Rs.13,867,196k (2025: Rs.14,129,768k) -- the only segment with a YoY revenue decline; Television +16.6% YoY to Rs.7,419,526k (2025: Rs.6,364,395k). BY SEGMENT operating profit: Mobile +45.3% to Rs.20,025,982k (2025: Rs.13,779,473k), the dominant driver of the Group's operating profit growth in absolute terms (+Rs.6,246,509k of the Group's +Rs.8,751,424k total operating-profit increase, i.e. ~71% of the improvement); Fixed telephony & broadband operating profit +46.0% to Rs.5,389,043k (2025: Rs.3,691,618k, +Rs.1,697,425k, ~19% of the improvement) despite its revenue DECLINE -- implying cost/capex discipline or a mix shift within that segment, not disclosed in further detail (gap). TELEVISION SEGMENT TURNAROUND: operating profit/(loss) swung from a LOSS of Rs.(356,581)k in H1 2025 to a PROFIT of Rs.421,055k in H1 2026, a swing of Rs.777,636k -- proportionally the largest segment improvement (loss-to-profit) though the smallest in absolute revenue terms (7.8% of Group revenue); this swing alone accounts for ~9% of the Group's total operating-profit improvement. BELOW OPERATING PROFIT: Net foreign exchange gain of Rs.505,217k this period vs a LOSS of Rs.(645,617)k in H1 2025 -- a Rs.1,150,834k favourable swing, a one-off/non-operating item embedded in the 'Finance costs - net' subtotal, quantified here per its materiality; gross Finance costs (excl. FX) also fell 14.8% YoY to Rs.4,207,382k (2025: Rs.4,936,110k), and Finance income fell 36.1% to Rs.354,713k (2025: Rs.555,146k) -- net effect: 'Finance costs - net' improved 33.4% YoY to Rs.(3,347,452)k from Rs.(5,026,581)k, boosting PBT growth beyond operating-profit growth. TAX: effective tax rate fell to 14.25% (3,209,253/22,509,992) from 23.6% (2,839,682/12,032,324) in H1 2025 -- tax expense grew only +13.0% YoY despite PBT growing +87.1%, a meaningful driver of PAT outpacing PBT growth; the filing gives no note explaining the rate change (no one-off tax credit/adjustment disclosed) -- flagged as a genuine disclosure gap, not further quantifiable from this filing alone. H1 2025 also carried a small 'Share of loss from associates' of Rs.(47,115)k, absent in H1 2026 (Group holds no associates generating a loss this period) -- a minor favourable YoY item. depreciation_amortization = 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment' per segment note, Group total Rs.24,413,362k (2025: Rs.23,896,988k, +2.2% YoY, modest vs the 9.3% revenue growth -- consistent with margin expansion via operating leverage on a largely fixed depreciation base). minority_interest = 225k (NCI share of profit; total PAT attributable to owners was Rs.19,300,514k). eps_basic=eps_diluted=2.10 (H1 cumulative, filing discloses identical basic/diluted). Cross-check: 19,300,514k*1,000 / 9,200,334,994 shares (Note 7) = Rs.2.0977, rounds to disclosed 2.10. Balance sheet as at 30 June 2026: trade_receivables = 'Trade and other receivables' (32,900,628k) -- the only receivables line disclosed on the face of the SOFP, no finer trade/non-trade split given (gap). trade_payables = 'Trade and other payables' (71,870,445k), current only (no non-current trade payables line). short_term_borrowings = 'Borrowings' (current, 52,282,082k); long_term_borrowings = 'Borrowings' (non-current, 19,012,000k) -- excludes Lease liabilities (current 2,016,281k + non-current 10,662,247k = 12,678,528k), which have their own line items and no FINANCIAL_FIELDS slot; not included in the borrowings figures, flagged so total leverage is not understated by omission. cash_and_equivalents = 'Cash and cash equivalents' (20,000,348k) per the SOFP face, GROSS -- i.e. NOT netted against Bank overdrafts of Rs.10,098,458k (per cash-flow-statement Note, doc p.08), which are instead included within the current 'Borrowings' figure per the SOFP's own presentation; the cash flow statement's own 'net' cash & cash equivalents figure of Rs.9,901,890k is a different (net-of-overdraft) construct, not used here to stay consistent with the SOFP face. capex = 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' only (10,685,329k, 6-month cumulative) -- EXCLUDES 'Purchase of intangible assets' (1,429,511k, mostly spectrum/software) per the standard convention used for other entrants in this DB (PP&E-only capex field); combined capex+intangibles would be Rs.12,114,840k, noted here since telco capex intensity is often measured inclusive of intangibles. cash_from_operations = 'Net cash inflow from operating activities' (46,386,554k, 6-month). cash_from_investing = 'Net cash outflow from investing activities' (-11,746,388k). cash_from_financing = 'Net cash outflow from financing activities' (-29,050,682k), which includes Rs.27,030,970k of dividends paid to ordinary shareholders during H1 2026 (2025: Rs.17,784,656k) -- a much larger cash dividend outflow YoY, consistent with the Statement of Changes in Equity showing Rs.20,240,737k of dividends declared/paid against retained earnings in the period (2025: Rs.9,200,335k). Post-period event (Note 20): Board proposed a further interim dividend of Rs.0.70/share for FY2026, confirmed solvency-tested -- not reflected in these June 2026 figures (a subsequent, not current-period, item).

interim_updates.note_text: Dialog Axiata PLC (DIAL) reported Group Revenue of Rs.95,515,048k for H1 2026 (six months ended 30 June 2026), +9.3% YoY (H1 2025: Rs.87,419,671k), while profit grew several multiples faster: Operating profit +51.2% to Rs.25,857,444k (2025: Rs.17,106,020k), Profit Before Tax +87.1% to Rs.22,509,992k (2025: Rs.12,032,324k), and Profit for the Period +110.0% to Rs.19,300,739k (2025: Rs.9,192,642k). By segment (Note 3, external revenue): Mobile grew +10.9% YoY to Rs.74,228,326k (2025: Rs.66,925,508k, 77.7% of Group revenue), and its operating profit rose 45.3% to Rs.20,025,982k (2025: Rs.13,779,473k) -- contributing ~71% (Rs.6,246,509k) of the Group's total Rs.8,751,424k operating-profit increase, by far the dominant driver. Fixed telephony and broadband revenue DECLINED 1.9% YoY to Rs.13,867,196k (2025: Rs.14,129,768k), the only segment to shrink, yet its operating profit still rose 46.0% to Rs.5,389,043k (2025: Rs.3,691,618k, +Rs.1,697,425k, ~19% of the Group's operating-profit improvement) -- implying cost or capex discipline the filing does not detail further. Television swung from an operating LOSS of Rs.(356,581)k in H1 2025 to a PROFIT of Rs.421,055k in H1 2026 (a Rs.777,636k turnaround, ~9% of the Group's operating-profit improvement) on revenue growth of +16.6% to Rs.7,419,526k (2025: Rs.6,364,395k). Below the operating line, a net foreign exchange GAIN of Rs.505,217k this period versus a LOSS of Rs.(645,617)k in H1 2025 -- a Rs.1,150,834k favourable one-off swing -- combined with gross finance costs falling 14.8% YoY to Rs.4,207,382k (2025: Rs.4,936,110k) to lift 'Finance costs - net' by 33.4% to Rs.(3,347,452)k from Rs.(5,026,581)k, pushing PBT growth (87.1%) well ahead of operating-profit growth (51.2%). The effective tax rate fell to 14.25% (Rs.3,209,253k/Rs.22,509,992k) from 23.6% (Rs.2,839,682k/Rs.12,032,324k) in H1 2025 -- tax expense rose only 13.0% despite PBT rising 87.1%, adding a further boost to PAT growth over PBT growth; no note in the filing explains the rate change. Basic EPS rose to Rs.2.10 from Rs.1.00 (+110%, matching PAT growth almost exactly, since shares in issue were unchanged at 9,200,334,994). At the Company (standalone parent, effectively the Mobile business only -- Company revenue of Rs.73,251,657k equals the Mobile segment's revenue-from-contracts figure in Note 15 exactly) level, growth outpaced Group: revenue +11.0% to Rs.73,251,657k (2025: Rs.65,974,666k), PBT +94.1% to Rs.17,755,609k (2025: Rs.9,147,578k), PAT +129.5% to Rs.15,778,906k (2025: Rs.6,875,475k), Basic EPS Rs.1.72 vs Rs.0.75 -- implying the Fixed telephony/broadband and Television subsidiaries, consolidated only at Group level, grew more slowly than the parent Mobile business this period, consistent with Fixed telephony/broadband's own revenue decline noted above.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is DIAL's first financial_statements/interim_updates entry in this DB (no prior quarter stored). Genuine filing-level gaps: (1) the Rs.1,150,834k favourable YoY swing in net foreign exchange gain/(loss) is a one-off/non-operating item embedded within 'Finance costs - net' and is separately quantified above, but the filing gives no forward guidance on FX sensitivity; (2) the effective tax rate compression from 23.6% to 14.25% Group-level (24.8% to 11.1% at Company level, an even larger compression) -- a bigger driver of PAT outpacing PBT than any single operating factor -- is not explained by any note; no one-off tax credit, deferred tax adjustment, or rate change is disclosed, so the reason cannot be determined from this filing alone; (3) Fixed telephony & broadband's operating profit rose 46.0% despite a 1.9% revenue decline -- the filing does not explain whether this reflects cost-cutting, capex timing, or a cost reallocation between segments; (4) trade_receivables and trade_payables are single SOFP-face lines ('Trade and other receivables'/'Trade and other payables') with no trade/non-trade split disclosed; (5) Company-level trade_payables (Rs.80,033,388k) exceeds even the Group figure, consistent with unconsolidated intercompany/related-party payables to subsidiaries embedded in that line, not separately disclosed; (6) Post-period Note 20 discloses a proposed further interim dividend of Rs.0.70/share for FY2026 -- a subsequent event, not reflected in these June 2026 figures.
interim_updates.takeaway: DIAL's H1 2026 profit growth (PAT +110.0% YoY) substantially outpaced revenue growth (+9.3%), and the gap is explained by three stacking factors, in order of size: Mobile segment operating-profit growth of Rs.6,246,509k (the core business, ~71% of the Group's operating-profit improvement), a Rs.1,150,834k favourable FX swing embedded in net finance costs, and an unexplained effective tax rate compression from 23.6% to 14.25%. The one segment showing revenue weakness -- Fixed telephony & broadband, -1.9% YoY -- nonetheless grew operating profit 46.0%, and Television swung from loss to profit, so no segment was a genuine drag on Group profitability this period. The risk to watch: both the FX gain and the lower tax rate are less likely to repeat next period than the Mobile-driven operating improvement, so YoY profit-growth comparisons could normalise even if the underlying Mobile growth persists.
operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.95,515,048k, +9.3% YoY (H1 2025: Rs.87,419,671k); Operating profit Rs.25,857,444k, +51.2%; Profit Before Tax Rs.22,509,992k, +87.1%; Profit for the Period Rs.19,300,739k, +110.0%.

By segment (external revenue): Mobile +10.9% YoY to Rs.74,228,326k (77.7% of Group revenue); Fixed telephony & broadband -1.9% YoY to Rs.13,867,196k, the only segment to decline; Television +16.6% YoY to Rs.7,419,526k.
Mobile operating profit +45.3% to Rs.20,025,982k, contributing ~71% (Rs.6,246,509k) of the Group's total Rs.8,751,424k operating-profit increase -- the dominant driver.
Television swung from an operating loss of Rs.(356,581)k to a Rs.421,055k profit (a Rs.777,636k turnaround), proportionally the largest segment improvement.
Net foreign exchange gain of Rs.505,217k vs a Rs.(645,617)k loss in H1 2025 -- a Rs.1,150,834k favourable one-off swing embedded in 'Finance costs - net', which improved 33.4% YoY.
Effective tax rate fell to 14.25% from 23.6% YoY (unexplained in the filing); Basic EPS Rs.2.10 vs Rs.1.00 PY (+110%).
key_drivers: Mobile segment operating-profit growth of Rs.6,246,509k (+45.3% YoY to Rs.20,025,982k) accounts for ~71% of the Group's total operating-profit improvement -- the single largest driver of the H1 2026 result.

A Rs.1,150,834k favourable YoY swing in net foreign exchange gain/(loss) (Rs.505,217k gain vs Rs.(645,617)k loss in H1 2025), combined with a 14.8% fall in gross finance costs, lifted 'Finance costs - net' by 33.4% and pushed PBT growth (87.1%) well ahead of operating-profit growth (51.2%).

Effective tax rate compression from 23.6% to 14.25% (tax expense +13.0% vs PBT +87.1%) added a further boost to PAT growth over PBT growth, but is not explained by any disclosure in the filing -- a genuine gap worth following up on.

Television's operating swing from a Rs.(356,581)k loss to a Rs.421,055k profit (Rs.777,636k improvement) contributed ~9% of the Group's operating-profit growth, the largest proportional turnaround of the three segments.

Fixed telephony & broadband delivered 46.0% operating-profit growth (to Rs.5,389,043k) despite a 1.9% revenue decline, contributing ~19% of the Group's operating-profit improvement -- implying cost/capex discipline not detailed in the filing.
